text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know how Maya just "gets" most 
things, right?

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering if your famous 
flashes of inspiration could solve love 
troubles too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Maya's a grown woman, but romance 
might be... a little too soon for me, 
maybe?

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"No need to be so stiff! Just think of it 
like a race."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—So you see, I think it's better to seize 
the initiative and aggressively push 
forward when that happens!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Maya, you made up your mind! 
Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Whether it's races or 
romance, leave it all to Maya♪

Struck by inspiration, Mayano Top Gun 
managed to give some useful advice.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"No need to be so stiff! Just try 
picturing yourself and someone close to 
you~."

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: Doesn't Maya have anyone she likes?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, there is, but...? They're 
mature, and they always support Maya--

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, come on! Stop worrying about 
Maya~~~~~!
After a series of twists and turns—

Instead, Mayano Top Gun ended up learning 
the ABCs of romance from her friends.
